title: Several I/O-matrix error-handling rows are shipped but have no test (400 / 409 / 404-not-owner / 422-archived)
evidence:
Spec matrix rows (in diff):
| Skip a non-queued live row | POST skip on a `contact_initiated` row | 409 `Conflict` (skip is a queued/pre-trigger action) | branded 409 |
| Unknown slot | POST skip with `:slot=fake` | 400 (invalid slot) | branded 400 |
| Not owner / archived vacancy | POST start, landlord doesn't own app | 404 / 422 (same prechecks as status PATCH) | branded |

Grep over server/test/ for `error_code.Conflict|InvalidPayload|VacancyUnavailable|contact_initiated|is already being contacted|Unknown reference type|isn't skipped` filtered to refcheck handlers returned: NONE.
detail: The guards are shipped (is_valid_slot→400, do_skip Some(_)→409, run_action_with_prechecks→404/422) but no test exercises any of them. The integration suite calls the core do_* functions directly, bypassing the handler wrappers.
recommended_fix: Add integration cases that drive the handler wrappers: unknown slot→400, a contact_initiated row skip→409, wrong-landlord→404, archived vacancy→422.
